You're asking the wrong question. Instead of asking others "what RTS is easy to mod" you should be asking yourself "what RTS games do I enjoy playing the most?", or even just "what RTS games do I play that would be 10000% better if I made subtle changes?"

Not all games can be modded in the same ways, using the same methods. Learning to mod one game will not necessarily prepare you for modding an entirely different game, so it's important to start with something you have a real interest in. Solving a problem that is relevant to you will make you more likely to invest greater amounts of time in it - particularly if the problems become more difficult than you anticipated.

Once you have an idea of what games you're interested in changing, you can start looking in to their modding communities for introduction material. The modding scene is huge, and there are tons of communities surrounding it that will help you get your footing.
